Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the timeline from Girls Who Code by assuming the 24% figure corresponded to 2022 (“today”) and calculating 2022 - 1995 = 27 years. The cited Girls Who Code source indicates 24% in 2017 and 22% in 2022; thus, the 13% change from 37% to 24% occurred over 1995 to 2017, i.e., 22 years.
